messages:
Eero: posted postmortem for repeated cache fallback delays, link: https://notion.redwood/pm/kv-fallback-game-day
OpsBot: Postmortem created by Eero. Please add remediation owners and closure criteria.
Mina: I'm taking the runbook template update. Goal: add closure_criteria and a short "game-day" checklist that can be used in a tabletop.
Cal: I'll own the canary procedure and a tiny automation that steps 5% -> 20% -> 100% with checks between steps.
Jun: I'll write the CI harness that runs the tabletop in staging and emits a PASS/FAIL badge; will upload artifacts to ACTION-55678.
Neha: propose closure criteria: (1) Runbook PR merged, (2) Canaries smoke test passed in staging, (3) Tabletop executed and artifact uploaded, (4) Playbook badge shows PASS. Include these as checkboxes in ACTION-55678.
Eero: adding a short "3-min quick triage" for oncall: exact copy/paste cmds and PD text.
```bash
# check cache evictions
kubectl -n inference exec svc/cache-inspect -- redis-cli INFO memory | egrep 'used_memory|evicted_keys'
# check hitrate
curl -sS 'https://metrics.internal/api/v1/query?query=(sum%28rate%28cache_hits_total%5B1m%5D%29)%20/%20sum%28rate%28cache_requests_total%5B1m%5D%29%29)'
# read current fallback state
curl -sS -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://control.internal/api/v1/fallbacks | jq .mode
```
Mina: For the gating rules, let's formalize PromQL: spare_capacity_pct >= 12 and error_rate_1m <= 0.8 and p95_latency_1m <= 260ms. Jun will plumb this into the harness.
Cal: The canary automation will: check gating, if OK step to next percent, pause 2 minutes, then validate error_rate and p95; it'll acquire a distributed lock so concurrent triggers don't overlap.
Jun: CI harness will run the automation against staging traffic, capture metrics snapshot per step, and upload JSON artifact to ACTION-55678; badge updated by a small service reading the latest artifact.
Neha: owners and dates: Runbook template -> Mina (due 2024-06-21), Canary automation -> Cal (due 2024-06-18), CI harness & badge -> Jun (due 2024-06-20), Tabletop exec -> Eero (session on 2024-06-22). Closure criteria assigned to ACTION-55678.
Mina: adding an escalation matrix to the runbook: oncall paged immediately; 3m ack window in US/EU, 2m in APAC; if no ack escalate to eng-sre; if post-fallback error_rate > 3% for 10m page infra-leads. Include PagerDuty playbook text.
Cal: note for oncall: do not jump to global fallback without running canary steps and confirming spare capacity; include example PD message to paste.
Eero: creating ACTION-55678 now and linking to the postmortem. Will add checklist and assign reviewers.
OpsBot: ACTION-55678 created and linked. Follow-up meeting scheduled for 2024-06-23 09:00 (invite sent).
Jun: I'll post staging harness artifacts here once run and tag PASS/FAIL. Expecting preliminary run tomorrow.
Mina: also scheduling a quarterly 'game-day' to run the harness in staging on schedule; will add a monthly lightweight lint job to ensure runbook fields exist (owner, action-id, closure_criteria, expected_side_effects).
Eero: thanks team — target to close ACTION-55678 within two sprints. :thumbsup:
